headline: Elevated Tail into the U.S. cash open
body: Premarket Nasdaq futures remain firmly higher after a sequence of earlier NQ assessments showing repeated upside extension and near-high retention. Current granular pullback evidence is incomplete, so Tail remains elevated rather than high before the cash open. Lower oil and Treasury yields support technology risk appetite while geopolitical and rate uncertainty keep Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: Tail was low through most of Sunday and early Monday, moved to WATCH as NQ strengthened, then reached the elevated band as repeated upside extension and near-high retention developed before the U.S. cash session.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is 29% / elevated. High Tail at the cash open is conditional on continued extension with shallow or failed pullbacks; meaningful two-way rotation would de-escalate the path. The base case normalizes after the opening window unless directional efficiency persists.

forecast.analysis: Premarket Nasdaq futures remain firmly higher and recent NQ assessments showed repeated upside extension, but fresh granular pullback data are incomplete. Tail stays elevated before the 13:30 UTC cash-open checkpoint rather than moving to the high band.
drivers: Lower oil and Treasury yields support technology risk appetite

12 UTC: Tail remains below WATCH in the base case ahead of the next U.S. cash-session setup; later central-bank remarks are scheduled checkpoints, not observed price-path evidence.

forecastDetail.comment: Premarket strength and prior near-high retention keep Tail elevated, but incomplete live pullback evidence caps the current score below high.
High Tail is conditional on post-open continuation with shallow or failed pullbacks; two-way rotation would invalidate the branch.
Elevated Tail requires the first full cash-session hour to preserve directional efficiency and repeated extension.
Tail stays elevated only if NQ retains extremes after the opening phase; broader two-way trade would reduce it.
WATCH reflects a still-intact trend with slower extension; a deeper retracement would normalize the path further.
Low Tail is the base case by midday unless renewed one-way extension appears.
